dispositions.required_remediation: Select an immutable App release asset, bind the exact owner, tag, URL, name, size, SHA-256 and applicable signature/notarization, then verify downloaded bytes before execution.
dispositions.forbidden_remediation: Do not bind the App script to an exact Base, Shell, Framework, or Package version, commit, SHA, Bundle, BOM, or same cohort.

dispositions.required_remediation: Select and verify the Framework bootstrap artifact by its own immutable release identity and digest before execution.
dispositions.forbidden_remediation: Do not turn the Framework artifact check into an App/Shell/Base/Package exact-version or cohort gate.

dispositions.required_remediation: Resolve the selected immutable App installer artifact and verify its exact identity and bytes before execution.
dispositions.forbidden_remediation: Do not use cross-component exact version or cohort equality as the download gate.

dispositions.required_remediation: Keep the finding on its own trust-boundary path: resolve Docker by an owner-authorized absolute path and reject user-controlled PATH hijacking before elevation.
dispositions.forbidden_remediation: Do not merge this finding into component-version compatibility or use component equality as its authority.

dispositions.required_remediation: Require an explicit per-transfer remote destination and privacy decision immediately before uploading local content; preserve a local or user-selected alternative.
dispositions.forbidden_remediation: Do not treat artifact version identity as a substitute for transfer consent.

dispositions.required_remediation: Replace matched credential bytes with redacted typed markers before result JSON, stdout, summaries, or uploaded artifacts.
dispositions.forbidden_remediation: Do not classify secret redaction as a component compatibility or release-version lock.
